External slot_generation survives generator UID resets and cancellation
Non-greedy/speculative/comparison work drains batch and runs exclusively; group quota/aging bound starvation
Reservations cover aggregate context, padded longest-row KV, extraction/logits/temporary space without adding RSS to Metal
Native single caches merge before batch capability checking; insert max_tokens is total output cap
Exactly one next() per tick; native single prefill slot cannot preempt long prefill for newly arriving short prompt
Completion uses upstream all_tokens/cache boundary; cache discarded, same-stream arrays retained and group close synchronized
Remove/close/constructor/partial-insert failures terminate affected requests and recover or stop safely
ASGI first-role disconnect cancels unfinished job; errors and bounded queues reach terminal state
Probe retains failed requests, requires seven cases, both directions, interleaving, cancellations, token equality and unchanged sources
limits: Independent review is not real-model evidence or competitive performance proof.

Hybrid native protocol compatibility remains distinct from real hybrid concurrency acceptance.
